title: 建筑字形穿行｜空间构件、尺度碰撞与广场回标
source_title: 白色字构城｜人物尺度穿过巨型字形与建筑孔洞
summary: 先建立白色公共建筑和微小行人的稳定尺度，再让黑色字形构件与门洞、圆环和立柱共用空间骨架；镜头连续穿过可读孔洞，字形由标记升级为空间实体，终局回到完整广场。
input_format: Declare a small exact text set, one restricted palette and one primary title before animation begins. + Build the primary title from visible components and reuse one of its letterform structures as the layout carrier. + Give each secondary word one distinct readable physical action inside the inherited structure. + Compress prior cards or grids into one central collision while preserving exact spelling. + Resolve all fragments into one complete terminal lockup and stop background, decoration and foreground together.
recommended_input: 建立原创象牙白雕塑园区，一名穿钴蓝外套的成年导览员横穿网格广场。；镜头跟随导览员穿过圆拱并从横梁下通过，同一批构件拆成三个可读空间分栏。；镜头拉远，把完整园区、导览员和重新组装的标题【AXIS / ARRIVE】统一在静止建筑主标中。
required_anchors: One architectural site, one adult scale anchor and one movement axis establish the baseline.
Every typographic component is built from visible structures already registered in that site.
Letterforms may separate or enlarge but cannot replace the established architecture with an unrelated scene.
The terminal wide shot reunites complete site, subject and exact original title in one stable lockup.
